0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 11th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-3, 12th in the West) for Orlando's eighth game of the season, as the Magic arrive on a two-game losing streak with a 0-4 home record and a 2-1 road record. Orlando is missing Anthony Black, Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, with Orlando's most recent meeting a 115-111 win in Orlando on March 31, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
